name: crm-rentacar-frontend
description: Assets del CRM: Tailwind, HTMX y Alpine servidos en local, sin CDN.

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/js static/fonts && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/alpine.min.js && cp node_modules/@alpinejs/focus/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/alpine-focus.min.js && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter-latin.woff2
